name: Contentful
symbol: Contentful SAML SP signing certificate rotation
title: Contentful: Contentful SAML SP signing certificate rotation (configuration change)
summary: The cut-over, originally planned for September 16, 2026, will now take place on Monday, September 21, 2026
replacement: Re-import the SAML SP metadata before the cut-over if your IdP supports multiple SAML certificates; if it supports only one, re-import the SAML SP metadata after the cutover on September 21.

name: Contentful
symbol: Expanded GraphQL fragment spreads per request limit
title: Contentful: Expanded GraphQL fragment spreads per request limit (configuration change)
summary: Effective date: October 12th, 2026 To improve GraphQL API reliability, Contentful will introduce a limit of 40,000 expanded fragment spreads per request
replacement: Simplify the query by reducing repeated nested fragment spreads.

name: Contentful API
title: Contentful API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/roles (behavior change)
summary: Starting February 15th, 2027, we will update how space roles are returned from the Content Management API (CMA) when listing roles within a space. The /spaces/{spaceId}/roles endpoint will switch from offset-based pagination to cursor-based pagination
replacement: Cursor-based pagination with a pages object containing next and previous links, using pageNext and pagePrev parameters instead of skip

name: Contentful
title: Contentful: Legacy periodic usage endpoints removed
summary: February 28, 2027: The legacy endpoints are removed and will no longer respond to requests
replacement: New Usage API: GET /metric and GET /usages-detailed

name: Contentful
title: Contentful: Legacy periodic usages endpoints deprecated
summary: Please review the breaking change and follow our migration guide to update your scripts to the new endpoints before February 28, 2027
replacement: The new /metric and /usages-detailed endpoints of the Usage API
